svg.title: Chunk files: tiny on disk
svg.desc: ChunkSerializer — RLE-compressed binary, decoded here from chunk_-23_12.bin written by the engine code for the seed-42 world.
svg.text: ChunkSerializer — RLE-compressed binary, decoded here from chunk_-23_12.bin written by the engine code for the seed-42 world.
on disk — 12× smaller than 1 byte per block
Blocks are stored x-first, then y: a full stone
layer is a single run, so the underground collapses.
Only for chunks the player modified, when they unload
and on exit; everything else is regenerated from the seed.
Magic + version 3: stale or corrupt files are regenerated.
